chapter: Arriving in New York and founding the Afro-Cubans
title: First rehearsal at Father Divine's hall
summary: They rehearsed in overcoats in an unheated hall at 122nd Street and 7th Avenue, for fifty cents an hour.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Frankie Ayala was the piano. All right, do you remember your first rehearsal?

Naturally, we were at the - our first rehearsal was at the Father Divine place 122nd. and 7th Ave. It was cold, we rehearsed with overcoat, the bass player had gloves, but he cut the tip of the finger in order to have, you know, to touch the string and they used to go out and buy coffee and, you name it, something hot to keep us warm because there was no steam heat. They charged us fifty cents an hour for the rehearsal.
